title: ai_transcribe function (Beta)
body:
The `ai_transcribe()` SQL function transcribes an audio file into text. It returns the transcript as time-stamped segments, and labels each segment with a speaker when speaker diarization is enabled for your workspace. The output is a `VARIANT` value, so you can chain it into other AI Functions. This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types).

See [`ai_transcribe` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_transcribe).
